Subject: MAP kickoff — rollcall, Zoom access, and evaluation matrix

Hi Ellis (and team),

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the Mutual Action Plan for the AcmeHealth integration. Quick logistics so we can lock the calendar and make the first session productive: 

- Proposed kickoff: Tue, Jun 9 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT (we'll timezone-translate if needed)
- Zoom: provisional link below (Ben will host and record)
- Draft agenda and evaluation matrix attached — please review and flag any missing stakeholders or evaluation criteria owners

Immediate asks: 
1) Can you confirm a single point of contact for clinical workflows and one for security/compliance (names + emails)?
2) Any required procurement or legal attendees for week-1 (we can keep them optional if you're still gathering approvals)?
3) If the proposed slot doesn't work, suggest two alternatives this week.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.docx, evaluation_matrix_v1.xlsx (see Drive link as well)

Zoom (provisional): https://zoom.us/j/987654321?pwd=example
Calendar hold: sent from my calendar once we confirm attendees

Thanks — aiming to have the MAP owner and evaluation owners named before the call so we can run the objectives and success criteria section in the first 15 minutes.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0198

Quick updates from my side:
- Clinical contact: Sara Moreno (sara.moreno@acmehealth.ai) — leads the pilot clinical workflows
- Security/Compliance: Dan Cho (dan.cho@acmehealth.ai) — will join week-1 as optional
- Procurement: procurement@acmehealth.ai will join if we need to lock the SOW/PO conversation, otherwise they prefer weekly cadence recordings

One ask: the proposed slot conflicts with a recurring board prep for Sara. Can we move to Tue, Jun 9 — 1:00–2:00 PM PT or Wed, Jun 10 — 9:30–10:30 AM PT? Either should work for Dan and procurement.

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood will record the call and whether notes will be shared? We need recordings for internal compliance reviews.

Thanks,
Ellis
Head of Product Partnerships | AcmeHealth
